title: A field named ___ is silently deleted by the reconstructor (NP-022)
rationale: processArrays skips any key where startsWith("__") and endsWith("__"). For "___" characters 0-1 and 1-2 are each "__", so both halves are true and the entry is dropped. The encoding side is blameless. The sibling "ok" is present so the fixture distinguishes "one field lost" from "reconstruction returned nothing".
catchesBugClass: Reserved-namespace collision: internal bookkeeping expressed as magic strings inside the user key namespace. Pins the defect so a fix is verifiable and the loss cannot silently change shape.
cannotCatch: It cannot prove the sentinel scheme is safe once ___ specifically is handled - a fix that special-cases the exact string would turn this green while __, __meta__ and __isArray__ stay broken. It also cannot catch the same collision on the Avro stack.

predicted.detail: The ___ entry is dropped entirely: a document with one fewer field, no exception, no warning, no null placeholder.
